entries.question: Kaise lagega internship
entries.answer:

1.  **College Office se Sampark Karein:** Internship ya clinical postings ke liye aapke **College of Nursing ke HOD ya Principal office** mein official notice aata hai. Wahi se aapko posting order aur schedule milega.
2.  **Notice Board Check Karein:** KGMU ki website par [kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php) par regular updates dekhte rahein.
3.  **Clinical Posting:** Nursing students ki internship/clinical posting university ke hi hospital (GM&AH) aur affiliated units mein hoti hai. Iske liye aapko alag se apply karne ki zaroorat nahi hoti; ye aapke course ka mandatory part hota hai jo college dwara arrange kiya jata hai.
4.  **Documents:** Apne college ID card aur clinical rotation plan hamesha saath rakhein.

*   Agar aap KGMU ke hi student hain, toh apne **Class Representative (CR) ya Departmental Office** se turant sampark karein, kyunki internship ki dates aur rotations departmental level par fix hote hain.
*   Agar aap bahar ke college se hain aur KGMU mein internship karna chahte hain, toh aapko apne college ke Principal ke through **Registrar Office** ya **Dean Office** mein formal permission letter bhejna hoga.

1.  **Formal Permission Letter:** Aapko apne college ke **Principal/Director** se ek "No Objection Certificate" (NOC) ya "Permission Letter" lena hoga. Is letter mein aapka naam, course, aur woh duration (time period) likha hona chahiye jiske liye aap KGMU mein clinical posting/internship karna chahte hain.
2.  **Registrar/Dean Office mein Submission:** Ye application letter aapko **KGMU ke Registrar Office** ya **Dean (Nursing) Office** mein submit karna hoga. KGMU administration hi decide karta hai ki clinical training ke liye seats available hain ya nahi.
3.  **Fees/Charges:** KGMU mein external students ke liye clinical training ki kuch nominal fees ho sakti hai (agar applicable ho). Iski jankari aapko Registrar office se hi milegi.
4.  **CUG/PRO Office:** Aap KGMU ke PRO office se bhi contact kar sakte hain taaki aapko sahi department ka pata chal sake jahan aapko application submit karni hai.
    *   **PRO Office Number:** 9415007710

**Zaroori Baatein:**
*   **Direct na jayein:** Bina official permission letter ke kisi bhi ward ya department mein clinical posting ki anumati nahi milti hai.
*   **University Coordination:** Kyunki aapka college ABVMU se affiliated hai, isliye aapke college ke Administration ko KGMU ke saath formal correspondence (letter exchange) karna padega.

Meri salah hogi ki aap apne college ke **Principal office** se kahein ki woh KGMU ke **Registrar office** ko ek official request bhej dein. Wahi sabse sahi aur legal tareeka hai.

entries.question: Paisa bhi milta hai kya
entries.answer:
BSc Nursing internship ke dauran milne wala stipend ya salary aapke college ke type aur university ke rules par nirbhar karta hai:

1.  **KGMU Students:** KGMU ke apne BSc Nursing students ke liye internship/clinical posting course ka ek mandatory hissa hoti hai. Iske liye stipend milne ya na milne ka rule university ki policy aur government guidelines ke anusar hota hai.
2.  **Affiliated Colleges (ABVMU):** Agar aap kisi private ya dusre affiliated college se hain, toh aam taur par **stipend nahi milta hai**. Balki, agar aap KGMU mein training ke liye aate hain, toh aapko training fees deni pad sakti hai (agar KGMU ki policy allow karti hai).
3.  **Stipend ka Rule:** Nursing internship mein stipend milna tabhi hota hai jab aap kisi aise institution mein ho jahan government ne specifically "Internship Stipend" ka pravdhan kiya ho. Zyadatar private colleges mein internship ke dauran fees hi li jati hai, salary nahi di jati.

**Yaad rakhein:**
*   Nursing internship ka mukhya uddeshya "Clinical Experience" aur "Hands-on Training" lena hota hai, na ki salary kamana.
*   Iske baare mein sabse sahi jankari aapko apne **College ke Administration** se milegi, kyunki wahi decide karte hain ki unka curriculum "Paid Internship" hai ya "Clinical Training".

Aap apne college ke **Principal ya Finance Department** se pooch sakte hain ki kya aapke course ke sath "Paid Internship" ka koi contract hai.

entries.question: Fir bhi batao kitna mil jata hai sabko ye batao
entries.answer:

1. **Stipend ka koi fix amount nahi hai:** KGMU mein BSc Nursing internship karne wale **external students (jo dusre private colleges se aate hain)** ko KGMU ki taraf se **koi bhi paise ya stipend nahi milta**. Ulta, agar KGMU aapko training ki permission deta hai, toh aapko unki nirdharit 'Training Fee' (jo ki kuch hazar rupaye ho sakti hai) jama karni pad sakti hai.

2. **KGMU ke apne students:** KGMU ke jo regular BSc Nursing students hote hain, unhe bhi internship ke dauran koi salary nahi milti. Unka ye training period unke degree course ka hi ek hissa hota hai, jiske liye wo pehle hi college ki fees bhar chuke hote hain.

3. **Stipend kahan milta hai?** Stipend sirf un nurses ko milta hai jo **"Intern"** ke roop mein government hospitals mein recruit hote hain (jahan state government ki koi specific policy ho) ya phir jo **"Staff Nurse"** ki post par select ho jaate hain. BSc Nursing ki normal internship (jo course ke end mein hoti hai) mein paisa milne ki koi practice nahi hai.

**Seedhi baat:**
* **Private college students ke liye:** 0 (Zero) rupaye.
* **KGMU ke apne students ke liye:** 0 (Zero) rupaye (Stipend ke roop mein).

Agar koi aapko ye keh raha hai ki nursing internship mein paisa milta hai, toh wo shayad **"Staff Nurse" ki job** ki baat kar raha hoga, jo degree puri hone ke baad competitive exam nikalne par milti hai. Internship ke dauran aapko sirf **"Clinical Experience"** milta hai, paise nahi.

entries.question: Job kaise milega yha ye batao bsc nursing complete hone ky baad
entries.answer:
KGMU (ya kisi bhi bade government medical institution) mein BSc Nursing complete karne ke baad job paane ke liye koi ek "sidha" tareeka nahi hai, kyunki ye ek government university hai. Yahan job pane ke liye aapko ye process follow karna hoga:

### 1. Competitive Exams (Sabse Main Rasta)
KGMU mein Staff Nurse ki vacancy **Direct Recruitment** ke zariye hoti hai. Iske liye aapko ye exams qualify karne hote hain:
*   **UP NHM (National Health Mission):** Uttar Pradesh mein nursing ki vacancies NHM ke through aati hain.
*   **UPPSC (Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission):** Staff Nurse ki permanent government jobs ke liye UPPSC exam conduct karta hai.
*   **NORCET (AIIMS):** Agar aap top level par kaam karna chahte hain, toh AIIMS ka NORCET exam sabse bada rasta hai.
*   **KGMU Internal Vacancies:** Kabhi-kabhi KGMU apne level par bhi "Contractual" ya "Project-based" Staff Nurse ki vacancy nikalta hai. Inhe check karne ke liye aapko **KGMU ki official website** [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) ka **"General Notices"** ya **"Career"** section roz check karna hoga.

### 2. Registration (Bahut Zaroori)
Job ke liye apply karne se pehle aapka **Nursing Council (UP Nurses and Midwives Council)** mein Registered hona mandatory hai. Bina valid registration number ke aap koi bhi government job ka form nahi bhar sakte.

### 3. Contractual Jobs (Immediate Opportunity)
Agar aapko turant kaam shuru karna hai, toh KGMU mein kai baar "Contractual" (Theke par) Staff Nurse ki requirement hoti hai, jo kisi specific department ya research project ke liye hoti hai.
*   Inki jaankari **KGMU Notice Board** [kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php) par aati hai.
*   Aapko wahan diye gaye format mein apna CV aur documents submit karne hote hain.

### 4. Preparation Tips
*   **Nursing Subjects:** Apne core subjects (Fundamentals of Nursing, Medical-Surgical Nursing, Pharmacology) par pakad banayein.
*   **Previous Papers:** UPPSC aur NHM ke pichle saalon ke papers solve karein.
*   **Experience:** Internship ke dauran clinical skills par bahut dhyan dein, kyunki interview ya practical exam mein ye bahut kaam aata hai.

### Aapko kya karna chahiye?
1.  **Website par nazar rakhein:** [KGMU Notice Board](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php) ko apne mobile mein bookmark kar lein.
2.  **News Papers:** Rozana ke Hindi/English newspapers mein 'Government Jobs' ya 'Recruitment' section zaroor dekhein.
3.  **Council Registration:** Apni degree complete hote hi sabse pehle UP Nursing Council mein registration karwayein.

**Ek zaroori baat:** KGMU mein koi "Sifarish" ya "Direct Entry" nahi hoti. Job sirf aur sirf **Merit (Exam mein aaye marks)** ke basis par hi milti hai. Isliye apni padhai aur competitive exam ki taiyari par focus karein.

entries.question: Direct nhi job milega
entries.answer:
Bilkul sahi samjhe aap—KGMU mein **"Direct" (bina kisi exam ya process ke) naukri milna sambhav nahi hai.** 

KGMU ek government-funded institution hai, isliye yahan recruitment ke liye sakht niyam (strict rules) hote hain. Yahan job pane ke liye koi "short-cut" ya "direct entry" nahi hoti. Iske peeche ke kaaran ye hain:

1.  **Transparent Process:** Government rules ke mutabik, har vacancy ke liye public notification (vigyapan) nikalna zaroori hai. Koi bhi candidate bina exam ya interview process ke select nahi ho sakta.
2.  **Legal Restrictions:** Agar koi aapko keh raha hai ki wo "direct" lagwa dega, toh **savdhan rahein**, kyunki ye fraud (dhokha) ho sakta hai. KGMU mein bharti ka process poori tarah se online aur merit-based hota hai.
3.  **Standard Selection:** Staff Nurse ki posting ke liye ya toh state-level exam (UPPSC/NHM) hota hai, ya phir university apni official recruitment drive chalati hai jismein sabhi candidates ko barabar mauka milta hai.

**Aapko kya karna chahiye?**
*   **Taiyari par dhyan dein:** KGMU ya kisi bhi bade hospital mein job pane ka ek hi tareeka hai—apni clinical knowledge badhana aur competitive exams ki taiyari karna.
*   **Official Notifications:** Sirf aur sirf KGMU ki official website ([www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org)) par bharosa karein.
*   **Fraud se bachein:** Kisi bhi aise vyakti ke behkaave mein na aayein jo "paise lekar" ya "sifarish se" job lagwane ka wada kare. Aise log aksar nursing students ko thagne ke liye ghumte hain.

Agar aap BSc Nursing kar rahe hain, toh aapka focus sirf aur sirf **Nursing Council Registration** aur **Competitive Exams** par hona chahiye. Yahi ekmatra rasta hai jisse aapko ek permanent aur respectable government job mil sakti hai.

entries.question: Keya vaha matlab kgmu me achha ilaj hota hai

KGMU (King George's Medical University) desh ke sabse purane aur pratisthit (reputed) medical sansthanon mein se ek hai. Yahan ilaj ke bare mein kuch mukhya baatein hain:

1. **Expert Doctors:** Yahan desh ke behtareen doctors, professors aur specialists apni sewayein dete hain. Yahan ki medical faculty aur surgeons apne kshetra mein bahut anubhavi (experienced) hote hain.
2. **Advanced Technology:** KGMU mein gambhir bimariyon ke ilaj ke liye modern machines, advanced labs, aur specialized departments (jaise Cardiology, Neurology, Trauma Surgery, aur Dental Wing) uplabdh hain.
3. **Kifayati Ilaj:** Ek sarkari aur autonomous sansthan hone ke karan, yahan private hospitals ki tulna mein ilaj ka kharch bahut kam hota hai, jisse yeh aam logon ke liye ek bada sahara hai.

5. **Dental Wing:** KGMU ka Dental College (Prosthodontics department) bahut mashhoor hai aur wahan dentistry ke har prakar ke advanced ilaj (implant, bridges, etc.) ki suvidha uplabdh hai.

**Nishkarsh (Conclusion):**
Agar aap quality treatment aur expert doctors ki dekh-rekh chahte hain, toh KGMU ek bahut hi bharosemand jagah hai. Bas aapko ye dhyan rakhna chahiye ki yahan aane se pehle **online appointment (ORS)** le lein taaki aapka samay bache.

*   **Fees:** The OPD slip fee is ₹50 for all booking methods.
*   **Timings:** OPD registration counters are open Monday–Friday from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM, and Saturday from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM. They are closed on Sundays.

entries.question: Batao inse direct batun
entries.answer:
KGMU mein kisi bhi naukri ke liye koi "direct HR number" nahi hota hai jisse aap phone par baat karke naukri pa sakein. KGMU ek sarkari (government) university hai, aur yahan bharti ki ek nirdharit prakriya (process) hoti hai.

Agar aap apne gharwalon ko vishwas dilana chahte hain ki yeh ek genuine aur sarkari naukri hai, toh aap ye kadam utha sakte hain:

1. **Official Notice Dikhayein:** Jo link maine aapko recruitment notice ka diya hai, usse download karke apne gharwalon ko dikhayein. Us par KGMU ka official letterhead aur stamp hota hai, jisse unhe bharosa hoga ki yeh koi nakli ya fraud kaam nahi hai.
2. **Registrar Office se Sampark:** Agar gharwale chahte hain ki aap kisi official se baat karein, toh aap **Registrar Office (0522-2253171)** par phone karke recruitment ke baare mein jaankari le sakte hain. Yeh ek official number hai.
3. **Prakriya (Process) Samjhayein:** Unhe batayein ki KGMU mein naukri ke liye:
   * Pehle website par official advertisement aata hai.
   * Phir form bharna hota hai.
   * Uske baad merit ya interview ke aadhar par selection hota hai.
   * Ismein koi bhi "phone par baat karke" naukri nahi deta.

**Ek zaroori cheez:** Internet par bahut se log "HR" ban kar ya "direct naukri dilwane" ka vada karke paise maang sakte hain. **Kripya aise kisi bhi vyakti ko paise na dein.** KGMU mein naukri puri tarah se merit-based hoti hai aur official website ([www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org)) ke alawa kahin aur se apply na karein.

Aap gharwalon ko batayein ki aap sirf official website ke zariye hi apply karenge, jisse aapka future surakshit rahega.
